results.title: Mask
results.overview: 440 crores stolen. Seven days to get it back. A game of greed, betrayal and intrigue culminates in an explosive climax in this story of a greedy man, a conniving woman and an uncanny guy with a bag full of tricks.

results.title: A Few Feet Away
results.overview: Santiago, a 20 year-old twink shaped by the anonymity of the virtual world, becomes frustrated with gay dating apps and starts obsessively looking for a real experience in the Buenos Aires nightlife.

results.title: Aan Paavam Pollathathu
results.overview: A year into their marriage, unable to distinguish between toxicity and mere misunderstandings, Sakthi decides to part ways with Siva. The couple navigate their separation, and whether they ultimately proceed with divorce forms the emotional climax.

results.title: Roads of Victory
results.overview: About the Soviet railway workers who heroically kept watch on the fronts of the Great Patriotic War.

results.title: Haunted Mansion | Disneyland Resort
results.overview: Welcome, foolish mortals! In honor of the Disneyland® Resort 70th Celebration, you're invited to step into a ghostly realm of happy haunts, eerie elegance, and frighteningly playful spirits in this immersive Point of View journey through the Haunted Mansion. From floating candelabras to ballroom waltzes beyond the grave, every spine-tingling scene invites you deeper into one of Disneyland Resort's most iconic attractions. Listen closely as your Ghost Host guides your Doom Buggy past mischievous phantoms and ghosts who are inviting you to a swinging wake. It's a wickedly delightful tribute to seven decades of storytelling where the magic of Disney meets the mystery of the afterlife.

results.title: Exes
results.overview: Two former FBI partners framed for terrorism and on the run in a war zone must team up to survive - only problem is they're divorced - and absolutely hate each other.

results.title: Reticent
results.overview: Sam is an emotionally reserved college freshman going through a very rough time. But when a tragedy occurs, he learns to express himself clearly.

results.title: Derniers soins
results.overview: While everyone wants to die "at home" without suffering and surrounded by loved ones, in reality almost everyone dies in hospital. What healthcare provisions enable people to die at home? Are we all equal in terms of the support we receive, regardless of where we live? Young caregivers in a home hospitalization unit drive day and night along the Alabaster Coast. From house to house, from dying person to dying person. Accompanying a dying person at home also means accompanying their loved ones, immersing oneself for a few days or weeks in the intimacy of a family history. Thanks to them, the end of life returns to the home, to the family, and is rehumanized.

results.title: #Iwilltellyouthetruth
results.overview: During a night shift, security guard Kiriyama watches a popular live streaming show titled '#Iwilltellyouthetruth' from the guardroom. The show is known for exposing the hidden truths behind sensational incidents and gossip, offering cash rewards and tips in return. The more shocking the revelation, the hotter the viewer reaction—and the greater the payout. In desperate need of money, Kiriyama decides to join the program and is eventually selected as a participant. However, what he faces is a truth far more immense and unimaginable than he ever anticipated. Truth always draws people in, but sometimes it can consume everything in its path. Depending on how people react, it may even reveal an entirely different face.

results.title: A Life In The Shadows
results.overview: Birgit is a pastor who has always lived a quiet, predictable life, closely following the path laid out by her parents.  But one day, someone from her past unexpectedly shows up during a sermon—someone she once loved—she’s forced to revisit a part of herself she thought was long gone. As buried feelings resurface, Birgit must ask herself: can the past offer strength, or only heartache?

results.title: The Chosen: Last Supper Part 2
results.overview: As Jesus speaks to a massive crowd, the religious leaders attempt to trap him in his own words. Afraid of public outcry—and further embarrassment—Caiaphas resolves to arrest Jesus quietly at night. Only one problem: no one knows how to find him…but they may know someone who can help.

results.title: Uncanny Valley
results.overview: During a camping trip, five friends are hunted by a creature that twists human appearance.

results.title: Eine halbe Stunde ist viel Zeit
results.original_title: Eine halbe Stunde ist viel Zeit

results.title: The Trip 8
results.overview: After meeting in Paris, Rosa and her French boyfriend Pierre travel to Colombia to get married and enjoy their honeymoon. However, everything changes when their in-laws reveal a shocking secret and try to stop the wedding, turning the trip into a chaotic and bitter experience.

results.title: Marina
results.overview: One year after she started her gender transition, Marina spends a summer weekend at the house of her best friend, Camilla. Everyone tells Marina how beautiful she has become, but she doesn’t feel like that. Instead, she constantly compares her body to Camilla’s, that she observes and portrays on her notebook. The arrival at the house of an impetuous male presence, with Lorenzo and his friends, will put to hard test Marina, Camilla and the friendship between them.

results.title: Brighter Days Ahead
results.overview: A short film accompanying the deluxe edition of "Eternal Sunshine," marking Ariana Grande’s directorial debut. Peaches, now elderly, revisits Brighter Days Inc. to relive idealized versions of her memories before they are destroyed forever. Inspired by the film "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind" and a sequel to the "We Can't Be Friends" music video.

results.title: Haunted & Devoted
results.overview: In the dark streets of Melbourne, vampire Chisuki finds love with fiery empath Isabel. But when death looms, turning Izzy binds them in passion-and hunger. As bloodlust rises, can their love survive the darkness?

results.title: Eyelashes
results.overview: A newcomer to London must choose between his Islamic faith and the opportunity of a lifetime.
